messages:
Priya (AE): BankX wants a 30-day reserved Dedicated POC in us-west-2. Key asks: single static egress IP if possible (their firewall team prefers one IP), and optional mTLS to authenticate clients. Procurement needs a line item: '30-day Dedicated POC + mTLS ops'. Who owns cert rotation and what's the fastest path to start Monday? cc @Noah @Lina

Noah (Solutions): We can do single EIP for POC but it's a single point; we recommend 2 EIPs for short HA. Pricing: I'll produce the 30-day line item plus a one-time mTLS setup fee. Need expected QPS/concurrency to size the pool.

Lina (Network): Technical: Dedicated pools NAT outbound via EIP(s) we allocate. Options:
- Single /32 EIP (OK for quick allowlist)
- Two /32 EIPs (recommended)
We can also publish a DNS alias but customers must allowlist IPs, not names. mTLS: on Dedicated we can enable client cert verification, but Ops must upload the customer's CA bundle.

Arjun (Infra): Started provisioning request (small pool, us-west-2). Reserving 1 EIP per request; can add a second if they prefer. ETA ~2 hours to hand off real IPs. We'll post them in this thread.

Marta (Security): For procurement/security: we will attach SOC2 and a short mTLS responsibilities doc. Rotation: customer retains responsibility for their client certs and must notify ops 72 hours before rotation; ops will schedule the rotation and apply certs. If they use Private, customer-managed KMS can be used for endpoint keys; otherwise Redwood manages endpoint TLS keys.

Noah (Solutions): Proposed quick-start flow:
1) Customer confirms single vs dual EIP and provides QPS.
2) If mTLS: customer sends CA bundle (PEM) and rotation contact.
3) We provision pool, reserve EIP(s), and share IP(s).
4) Customer allowlists IP(s) on port 443 and runs smoke curl test with POC API key.
If mTLS isn't ready Day 0 we can run with token auth + allowlist and add mTLS mid-POC (48h notice).

infra-bot: provisioning: dedicated small pool requested in us-west-2. ETA ~120m. Reserving 1 EIP.

Lina (Network): Placeholder firewall rule to give to their team: Allow outbound TCP 443 to 198.51.100.123/32 (placeholder). Test with:
```bash
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $POC_KEY" \
  --resolve dedicated-us-west-2.redwood.example:443:198.51.100.123 \
  "https://dedicated-us-west-2.redwood.example/v1/chat" -d '{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"ping"}]}'
```

Priya (AE): I'll get QPS from BankX and ask for the CA bundle if they want mTLS. Noah  please send the procurement line item ASAP. Lina/Arjun  please post the real IP(s) when infra finishes. Marta  please attach SOC2 and the mTLS note. :thumbsup:
